187

Called Meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas Sept 9th 1882
Hon R Clark Acting Mayor Presiding

Roll call present Aldermen Hartz Kinney Schuber Bruggenhoff Radkey Kurputz Norther Pease
Wilson Absent Alderman Cook

Call of the Council read which was for the consideration of Business connected with the
condemnation of State Temporary Capitol Building,

Alderman Norther offered the following
resolution
Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin that the Mayor be and is hereby
instructed to appoint a committee of three consisting of the City Engineer and two expert
Citizens to act in conjunction with the Committee appointed by the state of convenient to
examine and report the safety of the Temp orary Capitol under the authority granted to the
City Council by the Charter of the City of Austin Article 6 Section 22 Section 2 That the
Committee shall report to the Mayor as soon as practicable Section 3 That a copy of these
resolutions be sent to the
President of the Capitol Board
The resolution was amended by inserting after the word (by the State of Texas) if
convenient The yeas and nays being Called the resolution was adopted by the following vote
Yeas Aldermen Hartz Kinney Schuber Bruggenhoff Radkey Kurputz Norther Pease Wilson In
accordance with the above resolution the Mayor appointed the following as the committee Wm
Von Rosenberg J K. Robinson and J K Pine. Said City Engineer

On motion of Alderman Hartz the Council
adjourned.
Read and approved Sept 18/82.
A L Turner
City Clerk
Sept 18
